settings.label: About
settings.heading: A small shop that chooses slowly.
settings.text: Gavelli is an independent shop for people who live with dogs and cats. We keep the collection deliberately short, and most of what we look at never makes it here.

settings.placeholder_note: A calm lifestyle photograph: a dog or cat at home in natural light, warm neutral interior. Landscape 3:2.
settings.label: Why a short list
settings.heading:
Too much choice,
too little to go on.
settings.text:
Look for almost anything for a dog or cat and you'll find page after page of near-identical products, described in the same words. It's hard to tell what is well made from what simply photographs well.

We'd rather do that sorting before anything reaches this shop, so you don't have to.

settings.label: A note from the founder
settings.text: [Optional. To be written by Ian in his own words. Keep this section hidden until a real note exists.]

settings.title: Does it do a real job?
settings.text: It should help with something that comes up most days. Being new or clever isn't enough.

settings.title: Is it easy to live with?
settings.text: Simple to set up, easy to clean and sensible to have around the house.

settings.title: Can we describe it accurately?
settings.text: We only state what we've been able to confirm. If we can't confirm something, we don't claim it.

settings.label: How we choose
settings.heading: Three questions before anything goes on sale.
Not sure it's right for your pet?
settings.text: Ask before you order. We'd rather you bought the right thing than anything at all.
